node.title: Re^3: Test::More fails...
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
$comp_pass2 should contain a floating point between -1 and +1.

That could explain the problem - [https://floating-point-gui.de/|What Every Programmer Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic]. Is compare guaranteed to return the integer 1 in that case, or could it be returning a floating-point number that is so close to 1 that it is just being shown as 1? ([id://11127782|see for example])
